questions.question: What is Microsoft Copilot Studio?
options: A graphical, low-code tool for building agents and agent flows
A code-first SDK that requires C# or Python
A dashboard builder for Power BI reports
A tool that can only tweak the built-in Microsoft 365 Copilot
questions.explanation: Copilot Studio is a graphical, low-code environment for building agents and agent flows, making agent creation accessible without deep technical skills.

questions.question: In Copilot Studio, what is a "topic"?
options: A portion of a conversation, built on a canvas from one or more nodes that send messages or ask questions
A single static FAQ answer that cannot branch
The channel where the agent is published
A type of user license
questions.explanation: A topic represents a portion of a conversation and defines how it progresses. It is built on an authoring canvas from nodes that perform actions like sending a message or asking a question.

questions.question: With classic orchestration, a user's message does not have to exactly match a topic's trigger phrase; natural language understanding matches the message to the best topic.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Trigger phrases teach the agent's language understanding. A message like "see store opening hours" can trigger a topic whose phrase is "check store hours" without an exact match.

questions.question: Select all the building blocks a Copilot Studio agent coordinates to accomplish its goals.
options: Instructions and context
Knowledge sources
Topics and tools
Triggers
The user's local antivirus software
questions.explanation: An agent coordinates language models along with instructions, context, knowledge sources, topics, tools, inputs, and triggers. Antivirus software is not part of an agent.

questions.question: Select all supported knowledge sources for a Copilot Studio agent.
options: Public websites, searched via Bing over the sites you provide
SharePoint
Dataverse
Enterprise data made available through connectors
A hand-typed FAQ is the only option available
questions.explanation: Knowledge sources include public websites, SharePoint, Dataverse, uploaded documents, and enterprise data via connectors, all of which help ground the agent's answers.

questions.question: Before customers can engage with a Copilot Studio agent, what must you do?
options: Publish the agent, and republish after changes; publishing applies to all connected channels
Nothing; agents are live for customers the moment they are created
Publish every channel completely separately, with no shared step
Accept that agents can only ever run in Microsoft Teams
questions.explanation: You must publish an agent before customers can use it, and republish after changes. Publishing applies to all the channels connected to the agent.
